classes.desc: Cryptists are the ultimate researchers, delving into forbidden truths hidden throughout the galaxy and binding themselves to occult secrets that grant power beyond mortal understanding. They wield Occult Magic drawn from pacts with unseen powers.

classes.desc: Disciples cultivate the connection between body and soul, channeling an energy called Essence through their bodies to accomplish incredible feats of martial prowess. Disciple is the Neon Odyssey expression of the Monk.

classes.name: Enforcer

classes.desc: Primalists are bio-shamans bonded to the primal forces of alien nature, wielding living flora, fauna, and the world-souls of planets. Primalist is the Neon Odyssey expression of the Druid.

classes.name: Tracer
classes.desc: Tracers are rugged bounty hunters and trackers who blend keen senses, gadgetry, and firepower to run down any quarry. Tracer is the Neon Odyssey expression of the Ranger.

classes.name: Soldier
classes.desc: Neon Odyssey — the Soldier is the Neon Odyssey expression of the Fighter. Transcribed from the Outrunner's Handbook (Playtest v0.1.1). Drag onto a character sheet to run its level-up flow. Soldiers are combat experts with the skill and discipline to fight and survive in a galaxy at war. Their training and experience have earned them mastery of the weapons, armor, and equipment needed to claim victory on battlefields of any scale — from planning to execution to aftermath. Whether career military, conscripts, veteran mercenaries, bodyguards, or bounty hunters, the art of battle is their shared language, and they drill relentlessly to master it. Core Soldier Traits Primary Ability: Strength or Dexterity Hit Point Die: D10 per Soldier level Saving Throw Proficiencies: Strength & Constitution Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2 — Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, Perception, Stealth, or Survival Weapon Proficiencies: Simple and Martial weapons Armor Training: Light, Medium, and Heavy armor and Shields Starting Equipment: Choose A, B, or C — (A) Heavy Armor, Mag Flail, Breach Rifle, Heavy Laser Pistol, 2 Power Cells, 40 Shells, 2 Magazines, Outrunner's Pack, and $150; (B) Light Armor (Composite Weave), Quickblade, Saber, Plasma Pistol, Repeating Laser, 4 Power Cells, Outrunner's Pack, and $120; or (C) $11,000. Level Prof. Bonus Features Frontline Rally Weapon Mastery 1st +2 Fighting Style, Frontline Rally, Rapid Reload, Weapon Mastery 2 3 2n

subclasses.name: Symbiote
subclasses.desc: Dominate a Ravenous Parasite to Devour All Symbiotes are Espers who have turned the tables by mentally dominating a mind-bending parasite from the Abyssal Void, forming a symbiotic union in which the Esper maintains control. They unleash this ravenous aberration to shred and devour their enemies, feeding it their own psionic power and life essence to satisfy its hunger and keep it obedient. Some Symbiotes maintain an adversarial relationship of jailer and prisoner with their abyssal passenger, while others embrace the Void until the line between host and parasite is eliminated entirely.

subclasses.name: Deepsworn
subclasses.desc: Unmake Existence with the Annihilation of the Void The Deepsworn are Cryptists who scour the secrets of the infinite depths of the Abyssal Void and the prophecies that the Stardust Rhapsody will end how it began—in darkness. They dredge up the annihilating power of the Deep, unfathomable beings inimical to galactic existence, to unmake whatever or whomever does not fall into their cosmic designs. Many Deepsworn are drawn to the lost ruins of the Eldest in hopes to discover truths of what existed before the galaxy, while some look only forward to advance the unraveling of the song of creation.

subclasses.name: Supersprite
subclasses.desc: Power Up with the Heart of a Hero Supersprites are Enforcers who uphold the code of the arcade hero, drawing upon the power of Arcadia to seek grand adventures, courageously face evil, and rescue those in danger. They collect Arcadian power-ups that transform them for the challenge ahead, granting them the speed, strength, or resilience needed to defeat any enemy and clear any stage. Supersprites are typically bright optimists who believe there’s always another chance, but some are brooding loners who prove their heroism with deeds rather than cheer.

subclasses.name: Mutant
subclasses.desc: Warp Your Flesh with Mutagenic Horror The bodies of Mutants course with volatile mutagens that change them and grant them the ability to twist their flesh into grotesque new forms. From fleshy tendrils to extra shrieking mouths, these mutations rip apart enemies in both body and mind. Some mutants are transformed in an instant after being doused by radioactive ooze, while others are slowly changed from the eldritch corruption of otherworldly influence. You can choose the origin of your mutation or determine it by rolling on the Mutation Origin table. Mutation Origin 1d4 Origin 1 You drank something ancient, and it was a bit slimy. 2 You were exposed to the Void for an unknown amount of time. 3 You were subjected to an experimental treatment that had some unexpected side effects. 4 You fell into a vat of mysterious slime.

subclasses.name: Voidcaller
subclasses.desc: Herald the Eldritch Horrors Beyond the Galaxy Voidcallers are Oracles who call into the unknowable emptiness of the Abyssal Void and listen for when it whispers back. They open the way for eldritch entities from outside space and time to enter the galaxy and warp reality by offering their foes’ bodies and minds as a sacrificial meal. Most Voidcallers reach out to the infinite hunger of the behemoths of the Deep, but some find an indifferent or even strangely benevolent patron to serve.

subclasses.name: Headbanger
subclasses.desc: Thrash and Smash with Rocking Rebellion Headbangers are Icons who scream the song of existence with rebellious defiance to tear down anything or anyone that stands in their way. They unleash their unrest and aggression with thunderous bursts and brutal blows, transforming every fight into a frenzied mosh pit. Rock and roll rages in the heart of most Headbangers, particularly metal and punk, but some forgo music for activism, protest, and other acts of impassioned dissension.

subclasses.name: Eternal
subclasses.desc: Raise a Relic to Summon the Hero Within Eternals are Juggernauts who have discovered an ancient relic of mythic power that allows them to transform into a heroic alter ego of magical might. When this immortal power is called forth, they radiate with the energy of their ideals, which inspires friends and strikes down foes. This mythic transformation can render the Eternal virtually unrecognizable, and sometimes their personality even changes as if channeling a long-dead hero of old.

subclasses.name: Arc-Mage
subclasses.desc: Command Elemental and Curative Arcade Magic Arc-Mages are Gridrunners who plug into the video game realm of Arcadia, harnessing its digital origins to perform magic in the style of classic arcanists. With staff, wand, or spellbook in hand, they unleash the elements upon their foes and cure the wounds of their allies by spending tokens of arcade magic. Through Arcadia’s influence, Arc-Mage spells can sometimes appear entirely comprised of pixels and polygons, accompanied by melodic bleeps and bloops.

subclasses.name: Dreamer
subclasses.desc: Make Wishes Reality with the Power of Imagination Dreamers are Oracles who embody the energetic whimsy and unbound creativity of Arcadia. They commune with the arcade realm through fantastical dreams that they call forth into reality with nothing but their imagination, manifesting figments to aid their allies. While the imaginary friends of most Dreamers are cute, cool, or colorful, some tap into the darker corners of Arcadia to unleash their waking nightmares.

subclasses.name: Souljammer
subclasses.desc: Jam to Soothe and Stir the Soul Improvisation and flexibility are core to the soul-touching song of Souljammers. These Icons weave smooth melodies to soothe the hearts of their allies one moment, then erupt into a frenetic jam session to throw their enemies into chaos the next. While many Souljammers are jazz or blues musicians, there are those who make their mark through slam poetry and other spoken words.

subclasses.name: Protostalker
subclasses.desc: Become a Primeval Predator with a Dinosaur Packmate Protostalkers are among the most primal and untamed Tracers, fostering a mystical connection with protosaurs, especially primeval dinosaurs and prehistoric reptiles found across the Stardust Rhapsody. Together, they stalk the primordial wilds, honing their instinct to hunt and fight as one. Many Protostalkers seek out the biggest and most ferocious game of the galaxy, collecting trophies from prehistoric titans that could never be taken down alone.

subclasses.name: Chemboss
subclasses.desc: Command the Underworld with Chemical Assistance The seedy and ruthless underbelly of the galaxy is where Chembosses thrive. They produce and administer a variety of chemical compounds that enhance the abilities of their associates and compromise the faculties of their opponents. Chembosses work best with a crew that they can command with authority or support with chemical enhancements.

subclasses.name: Exomech
subclasses.desc: Pilot a Personal Mobile Suit as a Second Skin Exomechs are Soldiers who stride into battle at the controls of personalized mechs that are hardwired into their own bodies. They regard their mobile suits as extensions of themselves, reconfiguring them to meet the demands of each conflict. These Soldiers often customize their mechs with distinct designs, attachments, and paint schemes that reflect the pilot’s identity.

subclasses.name: Riftwalker
subclasses.desc: Tear Through Time and Space with Your Mind The laws that govern the cosmos are no match for the reality- bending psionics of the Riftwalkers. These Espers rip open tears in time and space with their minds, stepping through dimensions in the blink of an eye and warping the fabric of existence with each jump. Unlocking such immense cosmic power can unravel one’s connection to ordinary life, so many Riftwalkers keep a talisman to ground them in the present lest they become lost in infinite futures or the space between worlds.

subclasses.name: Anomaly
subclasses.desc: Become a Glitch in the Code of Reality Anomalies walk between two worlds, their souls existing simultaneously in reality and the Hypergrid. This connection allows them to perceive the code underlying existence and bend it to their will, escaping the shackles of reality to perform feats most would deem impossible. Some of these living glitches eventually become digital wanderers within the Hypergrid, while others devote themselves to discovering just how many rules of existence they can break.

subclasses.name: Commando
subclasses.desc: Gear Up to Become an Army of One. Commandos are the best of the best, capable of diving headfirst into battle against overwhelming odds. They access an entire armory stored in the Hypergrid at the press of a button, instantly equipping the optimal gear for the fight at hand.

subclasses.name: Bloodhound
subclasses.desc: Bloodhounds hone their senses and wits to perceive every minute detail and draw the connections needed to track and outsmart their quarry, expert at reading people and situations alike.

subclasses.name: Cacophonous
subclasses.desc: Corrupt Body and Soul with Discordant Powers The Cacophonous are especially cunning Cryptists who seek to outmaneuver the wicked malevolence of the Discordant to claim their fiendish power for themselves. They rip open tears to Cacophony to corrupt the body, mind, and soul of their enemies, marking them to succumb to the influences of Entropy, Instinct, Progress, or Thrill. Although they harness evil itself, many Cacophonous preserve their own souls through rigid discipline and calculated maneuvering, although some fully embrace the corruption and ascend to a new Discordant state of being.

subclasses.name: Cyberguard
subclasses.desc: Cyberguards turn their bodies into instruments of justice through cutting-edge cybernetics, upholding that technology is the greatest equalizer. Augmented senses, enhanced mobility, and integrated systems make them unyielding protectors.

subclasses.name: Godhand
subclasses.desc: Godhands hold the power of the stars, gifted to them by the gods of Agathos or their divine vassals. Their souls are infused with divine starlight that they unleash through their hands, often focused through a blessed gauntlet or glyph, striving to embody their patron deity’s sacred tenets.

subclasses.name: Gravgunner
subclasses.desc: Gravgunners specialize in exceedingly complex, advanced technology that manipulates gravity and space itself, harnessing a condensed singularity or miniaturized warp gate as a devastating weapon.

subclasses.name: Harmonious
subclasses.desc: The Harmonious deeply feel and commune with the Harmony flowing through all things, from the first spark of life to the final dying breath, weaving its Vital and Somber aspects at once.

subclasses.name: Holostar
subclasses.desc: Glitz and glamour are everything to Holostars, who command the stage and captivate audiences with colorful holograms that perform alongside them, channeling star power through holographic tech.

subclasses.name: Hypercoder
subclasses.desc: Hypercoders are the ultimate improvisers who rewrite code in real time. With a simple input, they hotfix the Hypergrid to reconfigure their technomancy beyond its intended function.

subclasses.name: Operative
subclasses.desc: Operatives specialize in top-secret assignments and impossible missions, mastering infiltration and espionage. Their expert training and advanced gadgetry let them complete objectives undetected.

subclasses.name: Powertech
subclasses.desc: Powertechs fuse the natural and mechanical to forge enhanced suits of powered armor outfitted with integrated weaponry and adaptive systems, granting technological superiority in any hunt.

subclasses.name: Psychonaut
subclasses.desc: Psychonauts are navigators of thought, voyaging into the minds of others to alter perception, emotion, and even identity. These Espers are master telepaths who traverse ideas and memories.

subclasses.name: Quickdraw
subclasses.desc: Quickdraws are known for the blazing speed and accuracy of their every shot. These gun-slinging Scoundrels have a knack for marksmanship and misdirection with sharp, opportunistic eyes.

subclasses.name: Rampager
subclasses.desc: Rampagers are the ultimate unstoppable brutes who embody the destructive ferocity of titanic monsters. Their Surge becomes an overwhelming force, violently changing them into hulking behemoths.

subclasses.name: Remix
subclasses.desc: Remixes are champions of free expression, constantly reinventing rhythms that keep their movement and magic flowing. They set the tempo of every fight, pumping up allies and throwing enemies off beat.

subclasses.name: Renegade
subclasses.desc: Renegades take justice into their own hands when the system fails, enforcing their code with fists, fury, and whatever is in reach. They have little patience for honor or procedure, fighting dirty to smash injustice.

subclasses.name: Riveter
subclasses.desc: Riveters are scrappy engineers who approach their craft with an improvisational knack to quickly build and deploy rivet-firing turrets, controlling every engagement with a flexible perimeter of supporting fire.

subclasses.name: Scrapper
subclasses.desc: Scrappers build ramshackle gear and weapons out of scrap, forcing their crude inventions to function through sheer will alone, channeling their Surge into chaotic effects.

subclasses.name: Shadowtongue
subclasses.desc: Control the Living and the Dead with a Whisper Shadowtongues have uncovered the truths of mortal life essence and the ways in which the Harmony flows through living things, and they have learned how to manipulate and dominate it with their voice alone. They whisper secret frequencies to twist emotion and desire toward their aims, eventually discovering how to sever one’s connection to the Harmony to bind mind, body, and soul to their will. Many Shadowtongues find themselves in positions of power, guiding the galaxy from the shadows, while others forgo the concerns of the living and fully embrace the curse of undeath.

subclasses.name: Splicer
subclasses.desc: Splicers believe science is simply an expression of interacting with the natural world, fusing the scientific and primordial by splicing their DNA with the biology of alien creatures to enhance themselves.

subclasses.name: Stargazer
subclasses.desc: Stargazers find guidance in the heavenly stars that surround the Stardust Rhapsody, reading the course of fate in the constellations and calling down the divine power of the gods of Agathos.

subclasses.name: Symmetric
subclasses.desc: The souls of Symmetrics overflow with the Harmony’s vital and somber energies. They channel the forces of life and death through body, mind, spirit, and blade. Most seek to bring balance to the galaxy, though some devote themselves to a single aspect.

subclasses.name: Virus
subclasses.desc: Viruses are Gridrunners who have become the host of a digital contagion from the Hypergrid that they have learned to control, infecting enemies with malicious code that corrupts body and mind.

subclasses.name: Warhead
subclasses.desc: The minds of Warheads are unstable bombs of crackling psionic devastation. These volatile Espers erupt with explosive bursts of telekinetic force that indiscriminately rip apart everything around them.

subclasses.name: Worldspeaker
subclasses.desc: Worldspeakers are conduits of the living world-souls at the core of planets across the Stardust Rhapsody, forming spiritual tethers with these elemental entities to share in their power.

subclasses.name: Trooper
subclasses.desc: Lead Your Squad with Superior Tactics. Troopers are masters of battlefield coordination who use tactical expertise to lead their units to victory, shouting orders and stratagems that let their allies fight as a unified force.

subclasses.name: Arbiter
subclasses.desc: Become the Judgment of Life and Death Arbiters are Enforcers who stand at the precipice of life and death, serving as the firm hand of the Harmony to preserve its natural cycle and destroy threats to the balance. They wield the Vital aspect to protect lives whose purpose remains unfilled and unleash the Somber aspect to cull those who have lingered beyond their allotted time. Many Arbiters strive for balance by holding themselves to the same cycle, but some pledge themselves to a singular aspect, becoming Vital shepherds or Somber reapers.

subclasses.name: Echo
subclasses.desc: Tamper with the Timeline to Rewind Fate While time flows in one set direction for nearly all things in the galaxy, Echoes can manipulate their place in the timeline. They can glimpse alternative possibilities, skipping forward or rewinding to make their preferred future a reality. Some Echoes deliberately sought to control the force of time, but many unlocked their abilities through accidental meddling in powers they did not fully comprehend.

subclasses.name: Ghostframe
subclasses.desc: Infiltrate and Eliminate with Cybernetic Precision Ghostframes blur the boundary between flesh and machine. These Disciples channel their Essence through soul-linked cybernetic augmentations to become unmatched infiltrators and assassins. Some become instruments of death in service to secretive organizations, while others use their enhancements to protect the innocent from the shadows.

subclasses.name: Cybertronic
subclasses.desc: Render the Digital World into Reality The Hypergrid is more than just code to manipulate for Cybertronics, who are deeply linked to the realm and everything in it. They can surf into the digital world and render weapons, vehicles, and even living programs into reality with physical forms made of hardlight. Many Cybertronics spend as much time as possible exploring the Hypergrid, whether in person or through a digital avatar, sometimes even living second lives beyond the bounds of the galaxy.

subclasses.name: Hivemind
subclasses.desc: Command the Infinite as One Through Discordant Swarms Hiveminds are Primalists fascinated by the corrupting influence of Cacophony on the natural world and its ability to twist all life into malevolent mockeries of what they once were. They claim this union of Discordant and primordial for themselves, utilizing it to summon and dominate endless swarms of creatures corrupted by Cacophony. Most Hiveminds use this as a weapon to fight back against the Discordant powers and all else who would defile the wild, but some fall to corruption themselves and become agents of Entropy, Instinct, Progress, or Thrill.

subclasses.name: Nanomedic
subclasses.desc: Treat the Wounded with Nanite Field Medicine Nanomedics are Soldiers who use highly advanced nanomachines to save the dying on battlefields across the galaxy. Equal parts warrior and healer, these field medics perform critical triage and direct their countless microscopic bots to close wounds, neutralize infections, and even snatch mortally wounded comrades from the brink of death. Their nanite clusters can take a variety of forms when deployed, appearing as billowing clouds, crawling swarms, or beams of gel-like material.

subclasses.name: X-Agent
subclasses.desc: Pursue the Truth to Uncover the Unexplained X-Agents are Tracers who meddle with the strangest and most mysterious forces of the Stardust Rhapsody and investigate the uncanny and the unseen. They delve into esoteric technology and occult magic to secure and contain the abnormal and sinister threats to the galaxy that many don’t believe exist. Some X-Agents get involved in secretive organizations and conspiracies to control these discoveries for their own ends, while others seek only to protect the galactic citizenry from the unexplainable.

subclasses.name: Botnik
subclasses.desc: Build, Upgrade, and Command Your Own Robot Botniks are masters of robotics, they innovate in artificial intelligence and use it to create loyal mechanical assistants that protect them in their endeavors across the galaxy. These bots are smarter, tougher, and more upgraded for combat protocols than standard models, with unique personalities that often reflect the idiosyncrasies of their creators. Many Botniks view their robot creations as precious companions or even friends, while some see them as disposable minions to do their bidding.

subclasses.name: Boomdoctor
subclasses.desc: Engineer Chaos with Unstable Concoctions and Gizmos Boomdoctors are Machinists who delve into the strange and unreliable sciences to create madcap inventions with wild and unpredictable effects. They typically have a love of explosions, whether from the volatile chemical bombs they concoct or through deadly experiments they conduct on their foes with their prototype gadgets. Some Boomdoctors discover ways to master and control their strange inventions, but occasionally, one pushes the boundaries of reasonable science so far that they inevitably get caught in their own blast.

subclasses.name: Xenotrainer
subclasses.desc: Teach Primal Monsters to Battle and Transform Xenotrainers travel across the galaxy in search of xenomon, highly adaptable alien creatures that metamorphosize to take on the traits of their environment. These Primalists form deep bonds of companionship with three xenomon and train them to become their best selves and ultimately achieve their final metamorphosis. Most Xenotrainers view their xenomon as close friends or even family, and every challenge they face they do together, always striving to better themselves through training and teamwork.

subclasses.name: Primeval
subclasses.desc: Unleash the Elemental Calamity of Natural Disasters The Primeval are Cryptists who uncover the archaic mysteries of the untamed elemental chaos that still rages since the song of creation was first sung. They call forth the unbowed primordial wrath seen in natural disasters and brutal environments, unleashing formidable blizzards and devastating volcanic eruptions against those in their path. The Primeval are most at home in the remote and wild reaches of the galaxy amongst the prehistoric ruins they study, but some seek out the neon lights of civilization.

races.name: Zorbrak
races.desc: scythe-like appendages in addition to their arms. They are the consummate hunters with a powerful predator’s instinct and the supernatural ability to stalk their prey. Zorbraks typically lack any sense of fear, allowing them to seek and kill the most dangerous game across the galaxy without hesitation. Many are instilled with immense pride by the hunting trophies they have won over their lifetime and are driven by the desire to leave a legendary legacy. Zorbrak body types range from hulking to lithe, and their carapace can come in a wide range of hues from earthy to vibrant. They typically have a protruding, jagged maw and two sensory antennae, and they sometimes grow chitinous tendrils from their head.

races.name: Bitling
races.desc: Bitlings (BIT-ling) are a widely varied species that hail from the video game realm of Arcadia. The imaginative creativity and bombastic energy of the arcade plane infuse them with whimsical powers that change based on their inherent archetype—strong, swift, or soaring. Bitlings often travel through Arcadia and the galaxy beyond seeking shiny collectibles that power their magic. Many set out on grand quests seeking fun adventures, sidekicks to befriend, and loot to add to their collection. Unified by bright colors and exaggerated proportions, a bitlings’s appearance is only limited by one’s imagination. Their most common form is a bipedal animal of any variety, but there are those who resemble toy-like humanoids, walking inanimate objects, or even bizarre oblong shapes.

races.name: Greeble
races.desc: Greebles (GREE-bull) are a worm-like species driven by an innate desire to voyage across the galaxy. Said to be blessed by Pelogos the Navigator, they possess a supernatural ability to always sense the stars and navigate by their light. Many greebles are drawn to space travel of all varieties, whether as transport pilots, explorers, or anything in between. This extrasensory power and internal cosmic compass is so strong that none can doubt the navigation skills of the greeble. Despite their segmented worm biology, Greebles have a humanoid shape with nearly universally thin legs. They have pointed noses, disproportionately large eyes, and soft skin in shades of pink to more earthy tones.

4f5a8644285123c1.hint: Medium (4–6 feet tall) or Small (3–4 feet tall)

races.name: Yaungu
races.desc: to thrive and build remarkable civilizations in the most inhospitable of environments. Many yaungu have a deep appreciation for the sharing of and passing down of knowledge, whether it be through story, song, or written text. Some even seek out well-hidden truths or heavily guarded secrets so that the learnings can be shared by the many to lead to a brighter future. Yaungu tend to be tall and powerfully built, with long arms and prominent claws for climbing. Horns grow from the sides of their head, which many of them decorate with carvings or other adornments. Their shaggy, insulating fur is typically white or some shade of blue, but some yaungu sport pelts of brown, gray, or black.

9de5076e29a008a8.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Oozoid
races.desc: system that form them into a bipedal shape within a translucent membrane. While they hail from the deep seas of ooze on their homeworld, oozoids have since spread across the galaxy, and some choose to don special pressurized suits to more easily hold their form in any environment. Many favor self- expression across various media, including art and the creation of oblong “blobjects.” Bright and highly saturated colors of slime typically comprise the wide variety of shapes and sizes of oozoids. Some favor a singular color, while others are multi-toned with strong gradients. Many choose to morph their heads to evoke hair-like shapes.

e41e613d541c0566.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Aetheron
races.desc: connection to gravity and resist the effects of aether exposure. They typically prefer to live in outer space, often residing in massive space stations or spending their days aboard starships. Many aetheron believe that they were crafted by Khorabos the Architect from a proto form of aether that drifted through the cosmos as a crystalized rock. They often seek orderliness in their lives that matches the tenets of their god, and this sense of order seems to manifest around them innately. They are relatively short, often stoutly built, and are heavier than their size would suggest. Their skin tones are usually muted with casts of dull gray, blue, or purple, but they often have vibrant streaks of aether hues in their hair.

b4014d68c94d225c.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Benthos
races.desc: Benthos (BEN-thoess) are a people forever changed by the eldritch power of the Abyssal Void. Eons ago, their homeworld was ripped into a black hole and lost to the Wyrmways, the border dimension between the galaxy and the Void. They irrevocably transformed to survive the alien environment, taking on traits of the Void creatures known as the Deep. In time, they learned to harness dark matter, shaping it to their will and utilizing it in their magic and technology. Benthos are diminutive people with features reminiscent of deep sea fish and skin in shades of the Void. They typically lack color outside their glowing circular eyes and lamp-like lures at the end of the flexible stalk that grows from their head. Their mouths are especially wide and can unhinge indefinitely.

races.name: Gorgonite
races.desc: featured humanoids that emerged from toxic jungles of beautiful but highly venomous flora and fauna. This has made them highly adapted to surviving poisonous environments and all of the threats within, in no small part to their powerful magical gaze. Many of them have a deep appreciation for the balance of beauty and danger, accepting them as equal and necessary halves to a life truly lived. This can lead them to seek out death-defying opportunities across the galaxy. Gorgonites have a skin of soft scales that range from earthy to vivid, with all manner of patterning. Instead of hair, gorgonites possess tendrils atop their head that resemble snake tails, which can be shaped into a variety of styles.

1280fad3ff36b40f.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Zamani
races.desc: adaptation to handle heat, zamani thrive on their harsh desert homeworld. Many zamani have a stoic philosophy of acceptance, and many of the worries of day-to-day life can seem insignificant in the grand scheme of time. While some believe that their temporal powers make them the masters of their own fate, others believe nothing can be done to change one’s destiny. Zamani have sun-tempered skin that runs from dark earth shades to muted jewel tones with embedded gemstones that focus their inherent energies. Their heads have raised ridges and plates that serve as heat sinks, and their bodies are typically covered in elaborate, geometric patterns of gold that evoke the flow of time.

1f1c5c669bb91a98.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Nematoan
races.desc: Nematoans (NEE-muh-TOE-in) are a four-armed amphibian species with a voracious appetite. Their unique stomachs allow them to magically ingest traits of the things that they eat, temporarily enhancing their own abilities. This has led many nematoans to develop a focus on food and seek out new dishes to taste across the galaxy. Some become chefs or ship’s cooks, while others get into dangerous trades where exotic and even black market delicacies can be procured. Hailing from a world covered in putrid swamps, nematoans have physical traits that lend themselves to comfortable bog living, including webbed hands and feet, eye stalks, long tongues, and slimy skin that is typically earthy in tone.

d072a6aed6e0cb22.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Poggle
races.desc: Poggles (PAW-gull) are born lucky. Said to be the creation of the luck goddess Tykris the Dealer, the favor of fortune touches everything they do. While they use this blessing to seek prosperous and happy lives, they also can share their innate luck with others. Drawn to games of chance, they can be found at gambling tables across the galaxy. Some use their death-defying fortune to take extremely dangerous jobs where a little luck is required for survival. Others find themselves in the world of finance, amassing their wealth through risky investments. Poggles are a diminutive species covered in fur that is typically white, brown, gray, or pink, though it can grow in other hues. They have long, sometimes-floppy ears, small, bat-like wings on their back, and a wire-like tail that ends in a colorful puff ball.

races.name: Yoggoth
races.desc: Yoggoths (YAW-goth) are a strange species rumored to have been birthed from the eldritch dreams of the mysterious elder beings of the galaxy. Hailing from a remote homeworld scattered with the ruins of their creators, they experience otherworldly dreams said to be an echo of what brought their people into being. As the ultimate survivors, yoggoths are extremely resourceful and prone to recycling everything they possibly can. Many are drawn to salvaging operations, but some are driven to uncover the mysteries of their dreams and eldritch origins, not stopping until they discover the answers they seek. Yoggoths appear like alien flies in a bipedal humanoid shape with both leathery and chitinous hides that are typically earthy in color. They have large glassy eyes, four nostrils on their elongated snouts, and fleshy tendrils that can grow from their head or chin. Two pairs of leathery wings grow from their shoulders, from which they emit their infamous drone.

ac9e060afaac73fd.hint: Medium (about 4–6 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet

races.name: Tekal
races.desc: technology. Their souls are manifested from the vital and somber energies of the Harmony itself, granting them the ability to harness the cycle of life and death. Many tekal have an unbound curiosity in the natural world and a sense of wonder in discovering all aspects of the Stardust Rhapsody and galactic living. Their affinity to the unique intersection of harmonic and primordial powers typically grants them a unique appreciation for all living things. Tekal have solidly built bodies embedded with gemstones and glowing patterns of inlaid crystal that evoke the circuitry of their natural technology. They have typically humanoid faces and plants that grow from their heads to resemble hair.

0b083153b4f248fc.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Solari
races.desc: to ash. However, once they were consumed by the blazing radiance, they were reborn as an entirely new species by the will of Alara the Lightbringer. They typically exhibit the unbound passion of the Lightbringer, pursuing that which they value and love with vivacious zeal. Many solari seek to share their inner light and passion with people across the galaxy, guiding them toward lofty achievement. Solari tend to be gracefully built, with especially long, pointed ears and floating hair that spans a gradient of vibrant hues. Their soft skin can have the tone of any of the galaxy’s countless suns, ranging broadly from typical oranges, yellows, reds, and pinks to rarer blues, violets, and beyond.

f75bba77d0fa526b.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Clawderan
races.desc: proving themselves in combat and other physical pursuits. Many seek glory to honor Myrmona the Paragon, the war goddess with whom they hold a cosmic connection. While many clawderan seek the galactic battlefronts across the Stardust Rhapsody, some prefer to show off their athletic prowess through sports, dance, high-intensity industrial careers, and other such pursuits. Clawderan builds range from agile to brawny and come in a variety of body and fur types, their feline traits resembling the full spectrum of cats both great and small. They typically have a short layer of fur across their bodies, with the notable exceptions being their manes, tails, and fluffy tufts that might grow on their torso or limbs.

674df23d4d812a9f.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Isotron
races.desc: Isotrons (EYE-soh-tron) are wholly digital beings brought to life by a synthetic soul called a hyperspark. Originating from the digital realm of the Hypergrid, they are comprised of code that can be compiled into physical forms of hard light. This grants them an innate ability to interface with computers and manipulate software with a touch. Many isotrons live their entire lives within the Hypergrid, but others venture into physical reality to discover new experiences across the Stardust Rhapsody. In such a technological galaxy, isotrons have no trouble finding ways to put their inherent skills to use. Isotron bodies vary in shape, size, and color, and they are often bedecked with bold or saturated hues that glow from the code within them. Their heads are typically humanoid with built-in visors, but some are entirely flat with a digital face projected upon it.

516576a447c37baa.hint: Medium (about 4–6 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet

races.name: Varg
races.desc: Vargs (VAHRG) are a vampiric people corrupted by the discordant tone of Entropy through the envious yearning to fill the emptiness within them in the hopes it may quiet their pain. They hunger for the life essence of others, which they drain to briefly satiate themselves. Those who work to control or even master this craving avoid succumbing to its addictive nature. The rest become ravenous killers. Whether enticed by the ease of feeding within heavily populated areas or brooding in the remote reaches of far-flung worlds, the desire of a varg to fill the pit within themselves often leads them to achieve impressive levels of wealth or power—though it is never enough. Vargs have pallid skin in desaturated hues, and on their backs are leathery flaps that resemble cloaks. They typically have prominent foreheads, ears that evoke bat wings, and prominent fangs. All vargs have one or more patches of fiendish energy on their chest, neck, or abdomen that serve as windows to the emptiness within.

b5c08cc9a888f43e.hint: Medium (about 4–6 feet tall) or Small (about 2–4 feet

races.name: Pakku
races.desc: Pakku (PAH-koo) are a species of sapient plants with the combined elements of cacti and carnivorous flora. To survive their deadly, venomous homeworld, they have developed a variety of adaptations to overcome both predators and prey. Favoring the more lawless corners of the galaxy, pakku usually seek their fortune through grit and resolve. Many of them have a strong interest in the crafting and handling of weapons, especially firearms, striving to master the art of the duel with their implement of choice. Widely varied in shape and size, pakku appear as bipedal plants with spiny cactus bodies that are usually a shade of green. Their heads are typically topped with hair-like vines or colorful, exotic flowers with extra-wide, toothy mouths that resemble carnivorous plants.

41bfeb1471deb9da.hint: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet

races.name: Nilari
races.desc: doom of their homeworld by slipping into the Wyrmways and fusing their biology with the native creatures within. All nilari have the blood of the wyrm, with many of them embracing this draconic lineage to steel their body and mind against all that would seek to corrupt and destroy them. Some take this further and pursue might in all its forms to stand against the darkness of the void. Nilari are typically broader and beefier than their solari relatives, with physical traits of the void wyrm that manifest in varying ways, including pointed, fin-like ears, fleshy tendrils that grow along the jawline, jagged horns, plate-like scales, and claw-like hands. Their skin tends to have muted shades of purple, blue, or grayscale.

e5fdb4a23e7bba2a.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Flambego
races.desc: Flambego (flahm-BAY-goh) are a colorful avian species that hail from idyllic tropical islands where life is leisurely. Bearing a mystical bond with the revelry god Xavrius the Celebrant, they are an easygoing people who prioritize relaxation and fun as major virtues. Empowered by the magic of the party, most flambego seek to spread the carefree joy within them to people across the galaxy. They are often drawn to vacation destinations, but they won’t shy away from danger, especially when it threatens their chill vibes. Flambego possess the traits of all manner of tropical birds, sporting vibrant, colorful plumage and wings that line each of their arms. Their proportions can vary, and while many have long legs, necks, and beaks, others are compact and round.

races.name: Murexian
races.desc: treacherous deep. Evolution is core to all murexians, and they develop additional adaptations throughout their life to best suit them for their home environment and the galaxy beyond. This allows them to be equally comfortable on land as they are in the water. Many murexians have no fear of the future, trusting that they will adapt to whatever comes. Murexians have mollusk-shell heads with tentacled faces that resemble cephalopods such as cuttlefish, and their rubbery skin can rapidly change in color and pattern to aid in communication. As they evolve and gain new adaptations, they can take on the physical characteristics of crustaceans and other invertebrates of the sea.

a5bcfe2c36103cb9.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Terminox
races.desc: Terminox (TER-mi-noks) are a bio-mechanical people reforged by the discordant tone of Progress through the hyper-logical denial of emotion to build structures of control around their pain. Their indomitable bodies are designed to neither cease nor slow in the face of whatever obstacle stands before them. Typically driven to achieve perfection in the areas of their obsession, terminox are always seeking the next step of optimization. While some uphold an advancement of the self, finding a solitary path or embedding in a small unit, many assimilate into the collective and join the never-ending march of Progress. Terminox are a species built of fiendish metal with cables of synthetic flesh that cling to their frame like muscle. Their heads appear approximately skeletal, sometimes connected to cords that resemble hair. The parts that make up their construction are typically colored in shades of gray or red.

races.name: Amanite
races.desc: teeming with huge, voracious creatures. They have adapted to thrive in this treacherous environment, developing magical spores they harness to evade the predators that seek to devour them. Despite the threats that surround them, many amanites laugh in the face of danger and possess a love of adventure and discovery, seeking out mysteries to solve and relics to unearth. Amanites are a diminutive people who resemble bipedal humanoid mushrooms that can vary in a wide spectrum of colors, textures, and patterns reminiscent of a huge diversity of fungus. Most typically have rounded noses, feature caps on their heads, and can grow fungal tendrils that evoke hair.

e29e8fbf1619e199.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Zeticulan
races.desc: Zeticulans (zeh-TIK-yoo-lin) are one of the oldest and most enigmatic species of the Stardust Rhapsody, with some theorizing that they impossibly arrived from outside the galaxy. Their minds are so expansive that they have unlocked a psionic power that emanates past their own bodies and allows them to pierce into the minds of others using telepathy. Many zeticulans crave k nowledge above all else, desiring to study, understand, and catalog every aspect of existence down to its last atom. They are drawn to any opportunity to conduct experiments of all varieties or the chance to expand their mental databases. While many remain elusive and mysterious, there are some who venture to mingle with other peoples of the galaxy to learn through new and unpredictable life experiences. njjjjh ] Varying in size and shape, zeticulans are alien humanoids with smooth skin that is typically gray or green. They have thin, elongated necks, oversized, bulbous craniums, and large, dark eyes with slit-like pupils. Among the hairless majority, a few can grow shocks of vibrant, nearly neon hair atop their heads.

085cab9914dd7149.hint: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet

races.name: Saurian
races.desc: Rhapsody, appearing as humanoid versions of the galaxy’s numerous dinosaurs and similarly prehistoric reptiles. They bear a special connection with the Harmony and can channel its lifegiving energies through that spark. This connection manifests in an intimate ancestral connection that grants them special insight on how to approach their daily lives. Across five distinct lineages, saurians comprise a wide range of body types and statures, with each one reminiscent of a broader category of dinosaur. These grant them the traits of water-dwellers, fliers, predators, scavengers, and hardy grazers. They typically have naturalistic hues, but some have vibrantly prismatic scales.

9985e4b2d8de0eb8.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Glowblin
races.desc: Glowblins (GLOH-blin) are small folk who feel big and intense emotions with an inner neon radiance. This emotionial glow colors their physical appearance and shines with vibrant light. Many glowblins tap into this magic to entertain and influence, shaping light and sound to evoke powerful feelings. They're drawn to fun, color, music, and all things maximalist. Glowblins have colorful skin, hair, and luminous eyes that change to match their affinity for emotion and self- expression, taking on a wide spectrum of hues and shades. They also have large, expressive ears, sharp teeth, and prominent, often pointed noses.

03705f2807b3e439.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Dathu
races.desc: Dathu (DAH-thoo) are a ferocious people who have been transformed by the discordant tone of Instinct through their wrath and desire to tear down the perceived source of their pain. Despite this corruption, they remain free and can choose to restrain their aggressive urges or focus their rage on something rather than their impulse to commit mindless acts of destruction. Many dathu follow pursuits that allow them to give in to their destructive nature, favoring groups and organizations they can link to their personal hivemind. Others surrender to their corruption and join the endless skittering swarms of cacophony. Dathu possess insectile traits found in the forces of Instinct, with scaly skin and chitinous carapaces, often streaked with amber-colored resin. Their jaws are split into mandibles lined with jagged teeth that drip with corrosive acid.

races.name: Navili
races.desc: Navili (nuh-VEE-lee) are an ethereal folk who first stepped out of Arcadia and found a home in the Stardust Rhapsody. Their time among the mortal species changed them, but they never lost touch with the mystic power of their enchanted origin. All navili embody a primary ideal—valor, might, or clarity— tracing back to the virtues of the sages that first guided them from Arcadia. Drawn to opportunities for heroism and to embody their chosen ideal, navili regularly seek secrets and relics within ancient ruins or lost temples. They are typically willowy and graceful with skin that ranges from muted tones of nature to the brilliant blues, pinks, and greens of Arcadia, often marked with intricate runic patterns. Navili have shimmering eyes, broad noses, and leaf-like ears with several delicate points. A pair of prismatic, polygonal wings drift behind their backs.

2856d1c41d192264.hint: Medium (about 4–6 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet

races.name: Zephursa
races.desc: Zephursa (zeh-FUR-suh) are a small, ursine species that hail from floating cities atop a sea of clouds. They bear a special connection to the skies, allowing them to call the wind and even puff up in a cloudy form. They value the power of friendship, which they can genuinely manifest and harness to overcome challenges. With a spark of ingenuity and a clever knack for invention, many Zephursa are drawn to tinkering with gizmos and developing new ways of approaching daily tasks. Many zephursa are most comfortable soaring through the skies of worlds across the galaxy, but there are those who stay more grounded and find their joy in the community that surrounds them. Zephursa are little humanoid bears with colorful fur, often with pastel hues although more natural colors do appear. They have swirling cloud patterns somewhere on their coat that sometimes grow into bushier tufts of fluff. The clouds that encircle them when they puff up usually take on the prismatic color of their fur.

races.name: Raizo
races.desc: carry the power and ferocity of a raging tempest within them. Hailing from a world beset by never-ending, violent storms, they possess the supernatural ability to unleash the power of thunder, lightning, and rain to overcome staggering odds. They typically have a fearlessness against danger and overwhelming obstacles, often conquering any barrier in their way. This relentlessness has allowed many to master the elements and thrive in harsh, inhospitable environments. Raizo are typically tall, solidly built, and often heavily muscled. A pair of horns grow from the top of their foreheads, and they sport tusks from their lower jaw. Their skin runs in shades of red, blue, green, gray, or yellow. Many raizo display tattoos that reflect particularly important aspects of their nature or personality.

15f22ab3166d7dff.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Anitron
races.desc: Anitrons (AN-ih-tron) are living robots with a hyperspark—a technological soul originating from the Hypergrid and infused with the Harmony’s life energy. Scholars debate whether the first hypersparks manifested spontaneously, or if some inventor gave the first anitron their synthetic spirit. Their mechanical bodies are each designed for a singular specialty in which they excel and often fixate on executing through free will instead of programmatic dictate. Constructed from various materials and fashioned into a wide variety of body shapes and sizes, anitrons are one of the most physically diverse species in the galaxy.

3f292c35bfc16646.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Human
races.desc: Humans are the most populous species of the Stardust Rhapsody, found on virtually every habitable planet. They have no singular homeworld—legend says they simply stepped out of the Harmony on all worlds at once. Highly adaptable, the indomitable human spirit prevails through any trial.

dLxv96vt2B2KOEe2.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Rangor
races.desc: have the innate ability to become an unstoppable force that can smash through anything in their way. Having first burrowed out of an asteroid of crystalized aether, rangor typically have a wanderlust that keeps them in outer space. Many of them stay on the move and stop for limited periods of time at space stations, moons, asteroids, and other off-world locations. Rangor generally have broad, bulky builds with proportionally long arms that end in digging claws and short legs. Their thick hides are mottled with patches of tough scales, and they grow flaps of skin that resemble shaggy hair. A rangor’s nostrils sit in the middle of their forehead, and their short tusks continue to grow as they age.

59288a3fbf160d7d.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Jenovan
races.desc: Jenovans (jeh-NOH-vin) are the descendants of an artificial psionic species created through genetic experimentation to achieve a perfected lifeform. For eons, these bio-engineered creations intermingled with their creators until nothing but the jenovans remained, beings of enhanced physicality and fearsome telekinetic power. Whatever homeworld they once had was lost to legend, so jenovans became a nomadic people who wander across the galaxy and settle numerous planets in tight-knit communities. They often strive to perfect themselves within and without, pushing their abilities to the limit and beyond. Many seek mightier challenges and opponents to test their skills and train against. Jenovans have an appearance that betrays their genetically engineered origin, with unnaturally smooth skin in tones of gray, green, and purple. Their bodies are adorned with plates of natural armor as well as crystalline protrusions that focus their telekinesis. All jenovans bear either a prominent tail or a head tendril, though many have both.

races.name: Marsoom
races.desc: Marsoom (mar-SOOM) are a bovine species with especially alien biology that grants them psionic prescience and highly tuned danger sense. They have adapted to the strange red planet they call home, making their physical prowess no less formidable. Most marsoom believe that strength and safety come through unity, and they are typically welcoming to people of all creeds and origins. While they normally engage in diplomatic pursuits, marsoom are prepared to fight to defend what they value most. They appear as sturdy bipedal cattle but have large, dark, oblong eyes with a third on their forehead. A pair of antennae sprouts from between their horns, their tails are split into two bushy ends, and their skin, hair, and tufts of fur come in a wide variety of vivid, unnatural colors.

races.name: Motlien
races.desc: Motliens (MOT-lee-in) are an absurd people twisted by the discordant tone of Thrill through their indulgence in sensory overload to drown out their pain. They relish in antics and folly that spark maximum excitement, pleasure, and pain, all of which fuel their cartoonish and reality-warping magic. Driven to be thrill seekers at heart, many Motliens crave the most dangerous or bombastic environments they can find. Others turn to sharing their laughter, fighting their darker impulses lest they join the hellish circus of Thrill. Motliens resemble fools, jesters, and clowns, with rubbery, colorful skin marked with strange psychedelic or motley patterns. Their heads sprout fleshy tendrils that resemble a cap and bells, and they often have honkable noses, razor- sharp teeth, and long, slithery tongues.

0b99563374b3e7ab.hint: Medium (about 4–7 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet

races.name: Volcar
races.desc: Volcar (VOAL-car) are a species of earth and fire, with fully elemental bodies of lava that they can melt and solidify at will. Able to sustain themselves entirely on minerals, they are a hearty people who thrive on their volcanic homeworld. Many volcar are fascinated by and study cycles, especially the relationship between destruction and renewal. They are often nomadic, following seasons, currents, patterns, and other natural phases. Some prefer more social or political cycles, getting involved in governments or militaries. Their rocky hide runs a variety of earthen shades from dark obsidian to pale limestone, with a humanoid visage that appears like a chiseled statue or a natural rock formation. Glowing lava forms lines and patterns in their exterior and can ignite at a moment’s notice, turning their whole form red- hot and malleable.

races.name: Laika
races.desc: dogs of any breed, with an innate sense of loyalty to their community and anyone they consider a packmate. While all laika have a powerful bark and bite, most prefer to focus their efforts on cooperation and teamwork, particularly in the areas best suited to the talents of their respective canine lineage. Many of them strive to make a difference in their society, and a good number of historical laika have greatly benefited societies across the galaxy. Laika come in all shapes, sizes, and physical characteristics that evoke canine breeds. They are covered in fur of varying length and thickness, which typically features naturalistic colors and patterns but can sometimes be vibrant and prismatic in hue.

7ad0bd0470245dfb.hint: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

races.name: Skettik
races.desc: Skettiks (SKEH-tik) are a flightless avian species suffused with innate necromantic energy, the remnants of a cataclysmic ritual that killed and reanimated the world soul of their homeworld. These warped carrion-eaters use their necrotic magic to craft personal minions or strange relics from bone. Many skettiks are reclusive, shying away from places touched by garish sunlight, and often find themselves operating in the galaxy’s criminal underworld. Others find great success in business and as merchants, utilizing their shrewdness and skepticism to score the best deals. Skettiks resemble wingless vultures in a humanoid shape with scaly skin and sparse patches of feathers that range from grayscale to drab shades of other colors. They have long claws on their hands and feet that they use for climbing the huge trees of their homeworld, and their jagged beaks are filled with sharp teeth for cracking bone.

races.name: Jozza

races.name: Oculok
races.desc: Oculoks (AHK-yoo-lahk) are a cyclopean species that hails from a vast underground civilization. They are highly adapted to subterranean life with enhanced monocular vision that can see through inorganic matter and a magnetic touch that can manipulate metal to their needs. Seeking opportunities to put their metal-bending to use, many oculoks possess a keen interest in building, from structures to vehicles. Their societies typically favor cooperation and rigid structure, and most citizens find purpose in contributing to a collective of any scale. Oculoks have sturdy bodies covered in scaly, earth-toned skin and protruding armored nodules. Their heads are broad with lateral ridges and a spiked crown, with the most prominent feature being a large, singular eye. Their tails act as a built-in defense mechanism, ending in either a club or spikes.

races.name: Cygnian
races.desc: Cygnians (SIG-nee-in) are the star-touched of Agathos, once mortal beings remade by the will of the gods. Some were heroes who lived by the tenets of their favored deity so completely that they were chosen to ascend and begin their journey anew as a Celestial. Others were selected at birth due to prophecies of greatness in the stars, discovered places or relics of divine import, or caught the eye of a god on a whim. While some live their new immortal lives in the heavenly realm of Agathos, many return to the galaxy to serve the god that reforged them The physical form of cygnians is comprised of starstuff, with resilient skin and flowy hair that evoke the night sky and statues of sacred stone and metal.
